arguments.message:
Hi there,

The API rate limit is applied per API key (not per workspace) using a rolling 60‑second window. That means the system counts all requests made in the last minute continuously, rather than resetting at the start of each minute. If your calls come in a burst, you can hit the limit and receive `429` responses even though the average per‑minute rate looks well below the headline figure.

To see exactly how many requests remain and when the window resets, check the `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers on each response. Spreading your calls more evenly over the minute should reduce the throttling you’re seeing.

Let us know if you need any more details!
